channel.title: CIS 251 - Foundations of Cybersecurity :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description This course introduces the fundamental concepts of cybersecurity, including how digital systems communicate, common cyber threats, security principles, risk management, ethical considerations, and career opportunities in the field. Students will develop a cybersecurity mindset through case studies, discussions, and hands-on activities. Credit Hours 1 credit Course Overview This course serves as a basic introduction to cybersecurity with a focus on exploring common threats and mitigations. Students will learn key principles such as the CIA triad, authentication, authorization, encryption, trust, and more. The course will include case studies of common cybersecurity threats and incidents and discussions on how to prevent them in the future. Students should leave the course with a defensive mindset and an understanding of risks and vulnerabilities present in modern technology.
